أستوطأ (form X)
# أُسْتَوْطَأُ (ʔustawṭaʔu) /ʔus.taw.tˤa.ʔu/: first-person singular non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَوْطَأَ (istawṭaʔa)
# أُسْتَوْطَأَ (ʔustawṭaʔa) /ʔus.taw.tˤa.ʔa/: first-person singular non-past passive subjunctive of اِسْتَوْطَأَ (istawṭaʔa)
# أُسْتَوْطَأْ (ʔustawṭaʔ) /ʔus.taw.tˤaʔ/: first-person singular non-past passive jussive of اِسْتَوْطَأَ (istawṭaʔa)
